title: Dark Molasses Bran Muffins
summary: Soft, dark bran muffins made with buttermilk-soaked wheat bran, molasses and a scattering of raisins.
equipment: paper muffin cases or oil for greasing

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Soak the bran
steps.text: Stir the bran into the buttermilk in a large bowl and leave it for 10 min to soften.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Meanwhile heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan) and line or grease the 12-hole tin.

steps.title: Mix the dry
steps.text: Whisk the flour, bicarbonate, baking powder, salt and cinnamon together in the second bowl.

steps.title: Mix the wet
steps.text: Whisk the eggs, brown sugar, molasses, oil and vanilla into the soaked bran until smooth.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Fold in the dry mix with a spatula until only a few streaks of flour remain, then fold in the raisins.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Divide the batter between the 12 holes, filling them almost to the top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 18-20 min, until domed, the tops spring back when pressed and a cocktail stick pushed into the centre comes out clean.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Leave in the tin for 5 min, then move the muffins to the rack.

tips: The most common mistake is overmixing; stir only until the flour disappears or the muffins turn tough and tunnelled.
Do not skip the soak; dry bran makes a crumbly muffin.
Molasses makes them brown quickly, so judge doneness with the cocktail stick, not the colour.
Swap the raisins for chopped dates if you prefer.
storage: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 2 months. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
